ValidationRule.description: Service Profiles with the account management permission set can create/update a Account Team record when role is WX/WA Benefits Specialist, WA/WX Payroll Specialist, Customer Success Specialist, 401k Plan Consultant. STY-(STY-03549)
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND(
$Setup.NSP_Trigger_Switch__c.AccountTeamValidations__c!=True,
$Profile.Name <> 'System Administrator', OR( $Profile.Name = 'BPS Service', $Profile.Name = 'Contact Center', $Profile.Name = 'Retirement Services', $Profile.Name = 'PEO Service' ),
OR ( AND ( NOT(ISPICKVAL( NSP_Role__c , 'WX/WA Benefits Specialist')), NOT(ISPICKVAL( NSP_Role__c , 'WA/WX Payroll Specialist')), NOT(ISPICKVAL( NSP_Role__c , 'Customer Success Specialist')), NOT(ISPICKVAL( NSP_Role__c , '401k Plan Consultant')) ), AND ( NOT(ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(NSP_Role__c),'WX/WA Benefits Specialist')), NOT(ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(NSP_Role__c),'WA/WX Payroll Specialist')), NOT(ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(NSP_Role__c),'Customer Success Specialist')), NOT(ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(NSP_Role__c),'401k Plan Consultant')), OR ( ISPICKVAL( NSP_Role__c , 'WX/WA Benefits Specialist'), ISPICKVAL( NSP_Role__c , 'WA/WX Payroll Specialist'), ISPICKVAL( NSP_Role__c , 'Customer Success Specialist'), ISPICKVAL( NSP_Role__c , '401k Plan Consultant') ) ) )
)
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Service User can only select WX/WA Benefits Specialist, WA/WX Payroll Specialist, Customer Success Specialist, 401k Plan Consultant Roles
